reasoning: Data Connect Hub is a middleware service that provides a unified integration point for ingesting data from heterogeneous data sources. The core of the project consists of two binary service crates — an Apache Arrow Flight gRPC server (services/flight) and an HTTP REST API (services/rest) — backed by a library of data-source connectors (Postgres, S3, Elasticsearch, Milvus, Neo4j, SQLite, URI). While the repository includes a Go-based Kubernetes operator controller (dc-controller/) for lifecycle management on OpenShift, this is a supporting sub-component; the primary deliverable is the data access service itself. The Rust workspace structure, Kustomize deployment configs, and Containerfile-based multi-stage builds all orient around deploying and running the flight and REST services.
